description: Dependency-advisory exceptions. PRODUCTION advisories are NEVER waived and this file is not consulted for them — the production tree is at zero HIGH/CRITICAL and must stay there. Only development-tree advisories may be waived, itemised by advisory identifier, with a reason, an owner and a review date.
productionPolicy: zero HIGH or CRITICAL, no exceptions
developmentPolicy: zero HIGH or CRITICAL unless itemised below with an unexpired review date

developmentAdvisories.reason: Denial of service via unbounded expansion. Reaches the tree only through `minimatch`, and from there through eslint, its plugins, and @vitest/coverage-v8 — all development-only, none present in the Dockerfile `runner` stage. THE ADVISORY HAS NO CONSUMABLE FIX: it affects every release up to and including 5.0.7, and the only patched release is 5.0.8, whose changed export shape breaks `minimatch` (verified — overriding to ^5.0.8 makes `npm run lint` fail with `TypeError: expand is not a function`). There is no patched release in the 1.x, 2.x, 3.x or 4.x lines for minimatch to consume. Waiting for the ecosystem is the only available action; the exposure is a CI runner processing this repository's own glob patterns.
developmentAdvisories.reviewAction: Re-check whether eslint and @vitest/coverage-v8 have moved to a minimatch that accepts brace-expansion 5.x. If they have, drop this entry — dependency-policy.mjs fails on an exception that matches nothing, so the file cannot silently outlive the problem.

remediationRecord: At the audit baseline the PRODUCTION tree carried 3 HIGH findings covering 13 advisories: next@16.2.10 (proxy bypass, two SSRF, unauthenticated Server Function disclosure, two cache-confusion, DoS, unbounded payload, image DoS), postcss@8.4.31 (three) and sharp@0.34.5 (libvips CVEs). Closed by bumping next to 16.2.12 and adding `overrides` for postcss ^8.5.24 and sharp ^0.35.3, because Next pins postcss at exactly 8.4.31 and npm's only suggested 'fix' was to downgrade Next to 9.3.3. Production is now at zero.
